component.name: Rift
component.summary: Torrents and direct downloads in one fast, calm window

description.p: Rift downloads torrents, magnet links and direct HTTP/HTTPS/FTP links. Direct links are split across several connections and resume after interruptions; torrents use libtorrent with DHT, peer exchange and local discovery.
A browser extension for Chrome, Edge, Brave and Firefox sends downloads straight to Rift.
